subject.title: feat(ui): automatic session attention states in the sidebar

question: Should `lastRunError` become a new unnamespaced persisted `SessionEntry` field despite potential external session-extension slot collisions, or should the failure projection use a compatibility-preserving shape?
rationale: The PR changes a plugin-visible persisted session-entry namespace; choosing whether to reserve a new core slot or preserve existing extension registrations is an API/upgrade contract decision, not a purely mechanical UI repair.

options.title: Preserve extension compatibility
options.body: Use a compatibility-preserving projection or migration strategy so installed plugins with an existing `lastRunError` extension slot continue to load.

options.title: Accept the new reserved slot
options.body: Adopt `lastRunError` as a core-reserved SessionEntry property and explicitly document the breaking plugin-extension contract change.

recommendation.title: Preserve extension compatibility
recommendation.body: Use a compatibility-preserving projection or migration strategy so installed plugins with an existing `lastRunError` extension slot continue to load.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged sidebar work and the current proposal place this person closest to the intended UI and session-attention behavior.
